sources.title: Training Amharic Text Embedding Models for Passage Retrieval
sources.snippet: Our largest embedding model, RoBERTa-Base-Amharic-Embed beats all of the multilingual embedding models on the MRR@10, NDCG@10 and Recall metrics while having 1/5th of their param count.

sources.title: Optimized Text Embedding Models and Benchmarks for Amharic Passage ...
sources.snippet: Our proposed RoBERTa-Base-Amharic-Embed model (110M parameters) achieves a 17.6% relative improvement in MRR@10 and a 9.86% gain in Recall@10 over the strongest multilingual baseline, Arctic Embed 2.0 (568M parameters). More compact variants, such as RoBERTa-Medium-Amharic-Embed (42M), remain competitive while being over 13x smaller.
